value.rationale: Endomorphism monoids encode all quotients and retractions, a natural invariant not determined by the automorphism group. The theorem classifies all maps in an infinite two-parameter finite-semigroup family, includes independent noninvertible support collapses and fiber maps, gives a complete composition and idempotent criterion, and computes a nontrivial exact endomorphism count of 9530217 for the smallest two-sided case. This is a complete structural classification, not only another calculation of automorphisms.
